subject: Re: Sept 3 product demo — travel conflict, options to switch to recording + Q&A
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@helixhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick note: demo on Sept 3 — travel window clash

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for setting up the Sept 3 product demo (2:00 PM PT). Heads up — our cohort of stakeholders is traveling to the Northwest Health Fair that day and my flight back keeps getting rebooked. There’s a realistic chance we’ll land later than planned and some folks (Carlos included) may miss the live session.

Options that would work on our end:
- Move the demo a day later (Sept 4) — mostly doable but a couple people are in back-to-back site visits.
- Keep Sept 3 but send a high-quality recording + a live 30–45 min office-hours slot for questions the same day.

If you can share what’s easiest for your team, we’ll confirm quickly. Also—does Redwood have a short SOC2 summary we could share with procurement before the demo? They’ll want that ahead of a deeper technical conversation.

Appreciate the flexibility.

—Samira
Samira Patel
Director, Clinical Partnerships
Helix Health
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick note: demo on Sept 3 — travel window clash

Samira — thanks for the head’s up. Sorry to hear about the travel churn. We can absolutely accommodate; three practical options and what each looks like from our side: 

1) Shift to Sept 4, same time (2:00 PM PT) — full live walkthrough + Q&A (we’d need confirmation by EOD tomorrow to reshuffle calendars).

2) Keep Sept 3 live but record a full narration-led deck (12–18 min) and publish the recording by 6 PM PT the same day, then host a 30–40 min live office-hours session at 7 PM PT for any follow-ups. This preserves momentum and lets people consume the content on their own schedule.

3) Record a focused 20–25 min highlight reel (key workflows + integration examples) and share slides ahead; if needed we’ll schedule a short follow-up with your engineers the following week.

For procurement: attached SOC2-summary.pdf and the demo agenda (demo-agenda.pdf) — Priyom is copying in case procurement or security has deeper questions. Olga will run the recording and can convert it to a short highlight reel if you prefer option #3.

Please reply with the preferred option and whether Carlos should be treated as a decision-maker for timing. If you want option #2, we’ll plan to keep the 2:00 PM PT slot as planned and record it regardless so nothing is lost.

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
On Wed, Sep 1, 2026 at 10:25 AM Samira Patel <samira.patel@helixhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Sean — option #2 sounds ideal. We’d rather keep momentum and avoid moving calendars.
> 
> Carlos confirmed he’ll miss the live portion but will join the office-hours if we keep it at 7 PM PT. Can you share slides and the SOC2 summary with procurement today? Also would the recording be captioned / downloadable?
> 
> If captions aren’t available, a transcript would help.
> 
> —Samira

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick note: demo on Sept 3 — travel window clash

Perfect — we’ll go with option #2 and keep the 2:00 PM PT demo as scheduled. A quick plan from our side: 

- Live session (2:00 PM PT): full product walkthrough (we’ll record with captions).
- Recording published to a private drive link by 6:00 PM PT — downloadable MP4 + auto-generated transcript.
- Office-hours (7:00 PM PT): 30–40 min live Q&A hosted by Olga (technical deep-dive) and Priyom (security/compliance).

Attachments shared: demo-agenda.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf (attached). Drive folder with assets and the recording (after demo): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-demo-assets-helix

Carlos — we’ll treat you as a decision-maker on timing; no need to join the 2 PM live if travel blocks you — catch the recording + join at 7 PM if convenient.

If anything changes on your side, ping me and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Sean
